business_problem: New thinking required to reach 1 billion users In the past six years, the company and its customers have collected a massive amount of data, with the platform ingesting about 20 billion records every day.
solution_summary: New thinking required to reach 1 billion users In the past six years, the company and its customers have collected a massive amount of data, with the platform ingesting about 20 billion records every day. Migrating 6 years of data and 70 microservices to MongoDB Atlas In 2021, Powerledger took on a comprehensive review process and built a Proof of Concept that matched the massive scale the platform needed to handle in the future. This would complement its existing software and blockchain technology and would support its ambitious goal. Francesco Pagetti, Solutions Architect at Powerledger “We needed to demonstrate our platform’s ability to ingest a much higher volume of data, and cater to the 1 billion users we aim to serve in the future. We needed a level of scalability and flexibility that our previous relational database couldn’t offer”, explained Francesco Pagetti, Solutions Architect at Powerledger.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides relevance-based text retrieval across Powerledger's documents and application data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the high-volume operational and event data that underpins Powerledger's real-time analytics platform.

data_flow: Business documents, tickets, records, and other operational content stay in MongoDB Atlas Search and MongoDB Atlas, where search indexes or vector embeddings are built and then queried in real time to supply grounded results to applications, assistants, or discovery features. Upstream and downstream integrations include Google Cloud.
business_outcome: Transformed scale and performance: Nine hours to four minutes MongoDB Atlas demonstrated capability for immense scale, but Powerledger was also amazed by the cost-effectiveness of the platform as well as its flexibility and reliability.
